brief_evaluation.brief_name: Kerala Rage Brand Brief (v2 - with Supplements)

clear_sections: Shadow System (Supplement) - 'Viscous Breeze' definition adds critical implementation detail previously missing.
Shape System (Supplement) - specific polygon paths for 'Torn Edge' resolve ambiguity.
Data Visualization - clear semantic mapping of 'Primary Data' to 'Ink Gold'.
recommendations: Consider adding specific easing curves for data chart animations to match the 'Viscous Breeze' philosophy.

working_together: The 'Viscous Breeze' shadow physics perfectly aligns with the '[DEPRECATED_STYLE] Asymmetry' shape directives.
Data palette uses 'Ink Gold' for primary truth, reinforcing the hierarchy established in the main brief.

applicability_testing.information_heavy_context: Excellent. Data supplement provides clear rules for charts and density.
applicability_testing.emotional_context: Outstanding. Shadow and Shape supplements give developers clear tools for hero moments.
applicability_testing.form_context: Very Good. Input shadows (Solidarity Bleed) clearly defined for error states.
applicability_testing.navigation_context: Good. Elevation system defines 'Float' state for modals/menus.
applicability_testing.summary: The supplements have closed the remaining gaps in applicability, making this a complete system.

uncovered_edge_cases: Animation performance on low-end devices given the 'Viscous Breeze' complexity.
Data accessibility for color-blind users (Red/Green reliance in charts).
brief_evaluation.overall_assessment: With the addition of the three supplements, the brief is now comprehensive and executable. The 'Viscous Breeze' and '[DEPRECATED_STYLE] Shape' definitions provide the necessary technical specificity to match the high-level emotional philosophical goals.
